violation_type.title: Activities for School-age - Provide Indoor and Outdoor Active Play (26 TAC §746.2707(6))
violation_type.short_title: Activities for School-age - Provide Indoor and Outdoor Active Play
violation_type.typical_finding: Multiple children between the ages of 4yr-12yr were observed playing on their cellphones during the inspection.     Note: The caregiver prompted the children to put away their cellphones.
